[2026-07-28 | AAPL | Underweight | -9.0% | -13.1% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Underweight

**Executive Summary**: Underweight AAPL at $340.08 — trim into strength, do not exit and do not add. Work a light 20–30% trim of the existing position with limit orders into the 338–343 pocket (priority near 342.89), taking exposure to roughly 70–75% of the firm's standard mega-cap weight; if already at or below ~70% of standard, do only a 5–10% token trim. No new capital, no averaging up, no leverage and no option overlays bought into the 28–29 July earnings/Fed window (no options-chain data was supplied). Hold the residual core against close-basis levels of 329.21, 319.35 and 307.83 (20% stub), and re-risk only after the event clears.

**Investment Thesis**: All three risk seats and the Research Manager converge on the same action — reduce exposure, keep a core — and the only live dispute is magnitude: aggressive 25–35% trim to 60–70% of standard, neutral 30–40% to 55–65%, conservative 35–45% to 50–60%. The direction is settled; the sizing is where the decision is made, and my own record argues for the light end.

Why reduce at all. The aggressive analyst actually supplied the deciding evidence against his own side: the plan's own entry math is ~2.0% to the 346.71 upper band against ~6.1% of structural risk to the 319.35 swing low (≈0.3:1), with the 10-EMA at 329.21 and 1× ATR at 332.00 both ~3.5% BELOW spot. The bull's "accumulate at 329–332 with a stop under 319.35" is a hold-the-core argument, not a buy argument, and his question to himself — "if the trend is this strong, why is your entry 3.5% lower?" — was never answered. On momentum quality, the MACD histogram is 1.310 versus a 3.337 peak while price sits at a record close, and RSI is 68.90 versus 71.65 on that same high — exactly the "RSI stalling below 71.65 on a price high" flip condition listed in the bull's own technical work. The breakout is thin: 5-day volume ~45.7M versus 20-day ~50.0M, price 4.2% above the VWMA at 326.48, and the report itself grades breakout quality "medium at best." On event asymmetry, the entire gross-margin thesis rests on ≥48.5%, yet the only print in the dataset is Q2 at 49.27%, there is no Q3 segment/mix data, no valuation multiple (P/E, EV/FCF, FCF yield) anywhere in the materials, and a Fed decision lands in the same 48-hour window — so "the business earned its multiple" is a claim the evidence cannot support. And the footnote risks the bull skipped land on the same line item the thesis depends on: an effective tax rate stepping 15.00% → 17.46% that persists in every forward quarter, buybacks −25.3% with capital returned down to 57% of FCF from ~107% and share count down only 0.71%, and a $12,777M intangible build with no matching cash acquisition outflow implying roughly $13B of future amortization aimed squarely at gross margin.

Why Underweight and not Sell. Nothing fundamental or structural has been falsified. H1 FY2026 revenue +16.1% to $254.9B (Q2 +16.6%), diluted EPS +19.8% to $4.85 (Q2 +21.8%), gross margin +169bp H1 and +222bp in Q2 to 49.27%, FCF +63.5% to $78.3B with CFO/NI at 1.15x, net cash nearly doubling to $61.9B. The tape is a clean fully ordered stack — 340.08 > 10-EMA 329.21 > VWMA 326.48 > 50-SMA 307.83 > 200-SMA 276.79 — with higher lows 245.51 → 245.70 → 273.75 → 319.35 and no confirmed RSI or MACD divergence. That is a core to keep, and the conservative analyst conceded as much ("I would not advocate a full exit"). Sell means exit or avoid entry; the plan is a partial de-risking, so Underweight is the correct label.

Why the light end, not the conservative's 35–45%. This is where prior lessons bind. The 2026-07-21, 2026-07-20, 2026-07-13, 2026-06-30 and 2026-07-01 AAPL Underweights each lost 3–8% of five-day alpha for the same reason: cutting inside a fully stacked rising structure on proximity to resistance or a single divergence, without a printed trigger. My 2026-07-20 reflection states the rule explicitly — require follow-through below the trigger before trimming, and keep any pre-print trim at the light end. Today that trigger is unfired: there is a momentum-quality divergence, but no close below 329.21, no lower low, no volume-confirmed distribution. The conservative ladder compounds the error — cutting another 20–25% of remaining exposure on a close below 329.21 is only ~3.3% below spot, ~1.35 ATR, the exact whipsaw mechanism the neutral flagged. I adopt the neutral's disciplined middle: light trim now for event-risk hygiene, a measured ladder (10–15% on the first rung, requiring volume/breadth confirmation) rather than an automatic one, 346.71 treated as an invalidation/review level rather than a protective stop since it sits above spot and shields nothing through a gap, and staged re-risking only after 29 July clears.

Data gaps stated rather than papered over: no valuation multiples of any kind, no Q3 FY2026 segment or product-mix data, no social sentiment, no options chain or IV to price a hedge, and a news sample of only 20 of 142 records all stamped 27 July with zero coverage of 21–26 July. Because the multiple is unmeasurable, sizing stays conservative. What would change the call: Q3 gross margin ≥48.5% with a credible intangible/amortization disclosure plus a volume-confirmed close above 342.89 upgrades to Overweight on a staged basis; a close below 307.83 on expanding volume, Q3 gross margin materially below 48.5%, confirmation that the 17.46% tax rate and cut buyback pace are structural, or adverse mix/receivables commentary converts this Underweight into a Sell.

**Price Target**: not provided

**Time Horizon**: 1-3 months, spanning the 28-29 July earnings/Fed window and the Q3 FY2026 print; re-underwritten post-event

REFLECTION:
The 5-day alpha of -13.1% (raw -9.0% against a rising SPY) vindicates the Underweight direction outright, though the window spans only the 28–29 July event and cannot validate the 1–3 month re-underwriting plan. It supports the event-asymmetry leg of the thesis and undercuts the sizing argument: the light 20–30% trim captured only a fraction of what the conservative's 35–45% would have, and the 329.21 follow-through ladder fired only after the gap, so the discipline that was supposed to protect the position protected nothing through a binary catalyst. Lesson for next time: when the stated risk is a dated binary event, treat the event date itself as the trigger and size the pre-event trim at the heavier end rather than waiting for a close-basis confirmation that a gap will skip.

[2026-07-27 | AAPL | Hold | -9.9% | -12.5% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Hold

**Executive Summary**: Hold AAPL at benchmark weight (one standard allocation ≈ a 5% portfolio position). Put no new capital to work at the 2026-07-27 close of 336.91 and cap gross exposure at benchmark — trim only any excess above it, do not go below. Pre-commit one-third tranches that fire only after the 7/29–7/30 macro window and the FQ3 print clear: a pullback into 326–330 holding the 10 EMA (326.79) with VWMA 324.54 intact and RSI ≥45; a >339.57 daily close on ≥60M shares with the MACD histogram positive; or a clean post-earnings confirmation on margins, mid-teens revenue growth and an AI-monetization path — capped at one standard allocation total. Hard review at a daily close below 319.35; trend failure below 306.99 (50 SMA) means reduce to token/zero and re-underwrite. Horizon 1–3 months tactical, core re-scored at the print.

**Investment Thesis**: The direction is settled and only the price is contested — and the tell is that all three risk seats independently refused to buy at the current print. Why not Sell/Underweight: the bull's substance was never dented — revenue +16.6%, gross margin 49.27% (+222bps YoY), operating income +21.3% ahead of revenue, H1 EPS +19.8%, ~$62B net cash, ~$78B FCF on capex −27.7%, with a fully stacked trend (price 21.9% above a rising 200 SMA at 276.38, 9.7% above a rising 50 SMA at 306.99, higher-low sequence 246.70 → 273.75 → 319.35 intact, VWMA rising to 324.54, no overhead supply above 339.57). Even the conservative analyst conceded it is a high-quality business and did not argue to reduce or short — capping how negative the call can honestly be. Why not Buy/Overweight at market: the bear won the arithmetic. From 336.91 upside to the 347.08 upper band is +3.0% versus −5.2% to the plan's 319.35 invalidation, −4.8% to the 320.63 stop and −8.9% to the 50 SMA — 1:1.6 to 1:3 against, with ATR 8.14 (2.42%) putting invalidation ~2.15 ATR away; the aggressive analyst's 2.5:1 applied only to the conditional 327 tranche, not the current tick. Three secondary bear points also stuck: unconfirmed breakout volume (47.5M/49.6M vs 60.96M/62.97M/63.41M on the prior leg; VWMA is backward-looking), two independent momentum divergences (MACD flat ~8.93 while price ran +3.2%; RSI 79.79 → 67.29 as price rose 8.0%), and the unexplained $12.8B gross / $13.3B → $25.8B net intangible jump — recast by the bull as 'option value' but ununderwritten until the filing shows an accretion path, especially with buybacks cut 25.3%. Add a ~35x back-of-envelope multiple (unverified, an annualization of H1 EPS) into a zero-disclosure print inside the Warsh press conference (7/29, 14:00 ET) and Thursday inflation data. Where the bear overreaches: the conservative analyst's demand to suspend Trigger B 'until the trend re-proves itself' is too rigid — the 60M-share/MACD-positive condition is itself a defined proof — and the sequential-margin comparison is a weaker test than the expanded YoY figure. The deciding synthesis is the neutral framework, which dominates both extremes: the aggressive analyst himself will not buy at 336.91 (his plan is scaled entries at 326–330 with a stop near 320.6, adding above 339.57 only on 60M+ volume) and the conservative analyst will not reduce. When the strongest advocate refuses to buy here and the strongest skeptic refuses to sell, the correct expression is Hold — maintain at benchmark, freeze new capital through the event, and let pre-committed triggers, not headlines, deploy the single standard allocation of incremental exposure afterward. Size for a ±2 ATR (~±5%) single-session move as normal, not a tail; if at or above benchmark and the desk can define event risk via puts/collar, hold the core rather than trading around the print. Upgrade to Overweight if the print shows YoY operating-margin expansion without soft AI commentary, EPS growth near the H1 ~20% pace, and a close above 339.57 on ≥60M shares. Downgrade to Underweight if a tranche is stopped at a close below 319.35, filing notes reveal a large all-time-high-priced acquisition with no accretion path while buybacks stay cut, or guidance points to sequential margin compression into FY2027. Gaps not closable from the material: no consensus, no guidance, no options-implied move, no short interest, no verified multiple, no filing confirmation of the intangible jump.

**Price Target**: 347.0

**Time Horizon**: 1-3 months tactical, re-scored at the FQ3 print

REFLECTION:
The five-day window printed -9.9% raw and -12.5% alpha versus SPY, so the refusal to deploy new capital at 336.91 was correct in direction but the benchmark-weight Hold still absorbed nearly the whole drawdown; five days is too short to score a 1–3 month thesis, yet not too short to see that the ±2 ATR single-session sizing assumption badly understated a 5-day event-window move. What the window supports is the bear's asymmetry arithmetic (1:1.6 to 1:3 against buying) and the two momentum divergences plus unconfirmed breakout volume, which read as distribution rather than consolidation; what it undercuts is the bull's "fully stacked trend" and the 246.70 → 273.75 → 319.35 higher-low sequence, since a ~10% drop from 336.91 puts price through the 319.35 hard-review level and against the 306.99 50 SMA, meaning the plan's own trend-failure triggers should have fired. Lesson for the next similar setup: when the strongest advocate won't buy and the strongest skeptic won't sell, express that as reduced exposure rather than a frozen benchmark hold, and pre-commit a trim trigger alongside the additive tranches so a Hold cannot silently become a passive long into a 1:1.6–1:3 against payoff.

[2026-07-24 | AAPL | Hold | -7.2% | -8.3% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Hold

**Executive Summary**: Maintain AAPL at benchmark/standard weight and put no new capital to work at $333.02. The uptrend is intact and the operating numbers are strong (foreclosing Underweight/Sell), but the setup is a failed retest into 334.68/334.99 resistance on soft momentum with a binary Q3 print days away, so the add case at spot is only ~1:1 (foreclosing Buy/Overweight). Keep the 2xATR trail near 316.49 on existing longs and act only on closing prints. Defer the bulk of any add budget until after earnings: a small 25-30% orderly pullback tranche in 324.50-327.70 only if it holds above 319.35, a partial breakout tranche requiring a daily close above 334.99 on >=60M shares with no RSI/MACD divergence, and a reserve released only on post-earnings confirmation (gross margin near 49%, opex growth decelerating below revenue, buybacks re-accelerating).

**Investment Thesis**: This is a genuine, balanced Hold: the two sides did not disagree about AAPL the company, they disagreed about AAPL the price, and each conceded the other's decisive ground. The bull owns direction and it is unrebutted — a perfectly stacked, rising MA ladder (200 SMA 275.98 < 50 SMA 306.23 up 28 straight sessions < VWMA 322.80 < 10 EMA 324.54 < close 333.02, price 20.7% above the 200), a 07-24 +3.53% engulfing reversal that reclaimed the 10 EMA, and dataset-best fundamentals (Q2 revenue +16.6% to $111.2B, gross margin 49.27% +222bps, operating margin 32.28% despite R&D +33.6%, EPS +21.8%, H1 FCF $78.3B, net cash rebuilt to ~$61.9B). Even the bear refused to short into a rising 50/200 stack, which rules out Underweight and Sell. The bear owns entry and that governs new capital: the $333.02 close is below the 07-17 close of $333.74 and the 07-24 high of 334.37 failed under the 334.68/334.99 shelf; breakout R/R is only ~1.0-1.1:1 with %B at 0.79 and ATR 8.26 (2.48% of price); volume of 47.5M beat the prior three sessions but lagged the 61-63M prints of 07-15/17, and the Aggressive 'distribution' label is plausible but unproven; the MACD histogram's 0.908 is only the first uptick off 0.795 versus the 3.337 peak while the MACD line already peaked at 8.927 on 07-21 during price chop, so a clear of 334.99 without momentum confirmation is divergence risk, not a win; RSI 65.23 has limited headroom. The quality-of-earnings jabs survive largely unanswered — opex +21.3% H1 vs revenue +16.1%, tax 15.0%->17.46%, buybacks -25% YTD/-53% in Q2, CFO flattered by $11.3B lower cash taxes with capex -27.7% and $12.5B net intangibles added, and the fundamentals are backward-looking (newest filing is the 10-Q accepted 2026-05-01). The tiebreaker is timing: prior entry-caution here has cost alpha, but the cross-ticker GOOGL lesson applies — into a binary event with ATR at 2.48% and an invalidation line (306.23) ~8% below, a reduced pre-earnings tranche still pays full gap risk for a fraction of the upside, so timing rather than sizing is the lever. I therefore adopt the Neutral analyst's amendment over both the Aggressive 50% pre-earnings pullback tranche and the Conservative full removal/trim: hold the core, no new capital at spot, keep the volatility-aware trail, and cap total pre-earnings deployment near one-quarter to one-third of the add budget with the rest reserved for after the print. I would not go Underweight (the bear never argued the business or trend was impaired, and trimming into strength at a rising 50/200 stack before a catalyst is a worse trade than trailing), and I would not go Overweight (the disciplined bull case is 'wait for the pullback zone or confirmed breakout,' which is not what an Overweight instructs today). What would change it: upgrade toward Overweight on a post-Q3 close above 334.99 on >=60M shares with no divergence, or a controlled pullback into 324.50-327.70 that holds above 319.35 with gross margin near 49%; downgrade toward Underweight on a close below 319.35 combined with the MACD line rolling under its signal and histogram back below 0.79, or a Q3 print with revenue growth materially below ~10% or gross margin well below 48%, with 306.23 (50 SMA) as medium-term invalidation. Missing from the record and flagged, not papered over: no valuation multiples, no consensus target level or the size of the gap-to-spot, no guidance/segment splits, and no confirmed earnings date — so any price target here is technical, not valuation-derived.

**Price Target**: 345.0

**Time Horizon**: 3-6 months (spanning the imminent Q3 FY2026 print)

REFLECTION:
The -8.3% alpha over five days (raw -7.2%) supports the entry-side caution that drove the Hold: refusing new capital at $333.02 into a failed retest with a binary print days away avoided a gap-loss on fresh money. It undercuts the bull's "uptrend intact" leg and validates the GOOGL lesson that timing, not sizing, is the lever for pre-earnings deployment — though five days spanning an earnings gap is too short to judge a 3-6 month thesis or the $345 target. Lesson: when ATR is ~2.5% and a binary catalyst is imminent, treat the pre-print pullback tranches as effectively void and wait for closing prints after the event rather than staging any tranche in advance.

[2026-07-23 | AAPL | Underweight | +3.7% | +3.2% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Underweight

**Executive Summary**: Trim AAPL 20% now (25–30% only if the position is at/above target weight or tech is already overweight), selling into strength at $322.66–$327.74 rather than into weakness, and retain a 70–80% core because the primary uptrend is intact. Do not add at $321.66 and do not pre-commit the proceeds to a $315.20–$317.40 dip-buy; that shelf only becomes a buy if AAPL stabilizes on contracting volume, reclaims $321.38, and MACD holds above its 7.31 signal. Invalidation is symmetric: a close above $334.99 on >60M shares with MACD re-accelerating re-adds the trimmed portion, while a daily close below $305.47 (50 SMA) cuts the tactical remainder and $275.60 (200 SMA) is full-thesis invalidation. Horizon 1–3 months, re-underwritten at the late-July Q3 print and the ~July 28 Klarna event.

**Investment Thesis**: All three risk desks converge on a partial trim, so the only contested questions are the label, the size, and the proceeds. On the provided scale Sell means exit or avoid entry, which no desk advocates — the trader's own reasoning says "a full exit is unwarranted" — so the correct rating is Underweight: reduce exposure, take partial profits, keep the core.

Direction is decided by the fact that the bear/neutral evidence is an actual rejection, not proximity to resistance. AAPL closed at $321.66 below the 10 EMA at $322.66 (first such close since 6/30) after four consecutive lower closes off a +21.3% move in fifteen sessions, with MACD rolling off 8.927 on a contracting histogram and price just $0.28 above the VWMA at $321.376 — the entire July breakout cohort is at breakeven. That gate matters because of my own record: the 2026-07-13 Underweight (+3.9% alpha against me) and the 2026-07-10 Hold both failed by treating a nearby technical level inside one ATR as a rejection rather than a probable break. Those lessons required an actual rejection signal before trimming; that gate is now satisfied. The 2026-07-16 Overweight near $333, made into the parabolic extension, cost -1.8% alpha in five days — the freshest datapoint supports the trim.

Size is capped at a modest trim, not the conservative desk's cascade, because structure is unbroken: price remains above a rising 50 SMA at $305.47 and rising 200 SMA at $275.60, RSI 58.11 is still above 50 and reset without bearish divergence, MACD 8.107 remains above its 7.312 signal, and none of $319.35, $317.32 or $315.20–$317.40 has been decisively violated. The bull's own "do not chase, wait for $315–$317" concedes today's price is unattractive — which argues for trimming, not exiting a structural uptrend. The conservative schedule (30% plus further cuts at $321.38, $317.32 and $305.47) risks becoming a disguised liquidation on a sideways chop, and this desk's history of over-trimming confirmed uptrends is why I reject it.

I adopt the neutral desk's framework with two corrections. First, I reject the aggressive "paid either way" framing: the $315.20–$317.40 reload is not free optionality — if $321.38 fails and MACD crosses below 7.31, that shelf becomes resistance. Proceeds sit in cash/short duration until stabilization is demonstrated. Second, I reject the aggressive misuse of ATR: 7.92 is a sizing input, not a directional forecast that a down day is the median outcome. It argues for smaller size and wider bands, which is precisely what a 20–30% trim with a retained 70–80% core delivers. The aggressive 334.99 stop is likewise an invalidation of the trim thesis, not downside protection for the retained core — that protection comes from the $305.47/$275.60 levels.

What would change the call: a daily close above $334.99 on >60M shares with MACD re-accelerating upgrades to Hold/Overweight and the trimmed portion is re-added; a $315.20–$317.40 pullback that holds on below-average volume with RSI above ~45 is a legitimate accumulation entry and also upgrades. A close below $321.38 unrecovered in 1–2 sessions justifies a further small trim; below $317.32 removes tactical exposure; below $305.47 moves toward Sell; a break of $275.60 invalidates the thesis.

Explicit gaps, not papered over: no fundamentals model, no valuation multiple, no consensus or estimate revisions, no insider data, and a five-day news blind spot (July 16–21) with ~90% of records unsupplied. Klarna leasing is single-source and Apple-unconfirmed with revenue-recognition and margin-optics risk into Q3; China Qwen approval lacks Apple-specific financials; IDC's memory commentary is two-sided. Because none of it is quantified, no price target is issued — any number would be technical guesswork rather than a thesis.

**Price Target**: not provided

**Time Horizon**: 1–3 months tactical (re-underwritten at the late-July Q3 print and the ~July 28 Klarna event)

REFLECTION:
The 5-day window shows +3.2% alpha against the Underweight call, so the directional trim was wrong almost immediately — though five days cannot fairly judge a 1–3 month thesis, only the timing of the entry. What this undercuts is the core gate: the close below the 10 EMA at $322.66 after four lower closes was read as "actual rejection" when it was again a probabilistic break, the same error the thesis itself flagged from the 2026-07-13 Underweight (+3.9% against). The lesson is that a sub-one-ATR close below a fast EMA, with the 50/200 SMAs rising and MACD still above signal, is not a rejection signal — require a decisive break on expanding volume or an actual MACD signal cross before trimming into a confirmed uptrend, and when trimming, sell into strength with limit orders above the market rather than at it.

[2026-07-22 | AAPL | Underweight | +3.8% | +6.2% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Underweight

**Executive Summary**: Trim AAPL by ~25% of existing exposure at market (~$325.89), with a second tranche into $329–$333.74 strength, and complete the cut toward 0.70–0.75x target weight if no bounce arrives within roughly 5–10 sessions or on a daily close below $322.88 on expanding volume. Do not add new long money here; re-adding requires either a controlled hold of the $314.86–$317.31 shelf with VWMA still rising, or a staged re-risk above $335 on ≥70M shares with the MACD histogram re-expanding above 2.5. Keep the core for the intact rising MA stack and strong franchise, size tactical trades 25–35% smaller given ATR $8.02 (2.46%), and commit nothing into the unresolved Q3 event. Horizon 1–3 months tactical; core re-scored post-Q3.

**Investment Thesis**: Direction is not contested — the research plan, the trader, and all three analysts land on reduce; the debate is only about execution, which the neutral framing resolves. The evidence for trimming now is measurable and forward-looking: the MACD histogram collapsed 3.337 (07-17) → 1.599 (07-22), −52% in four sessions, with the MACD line rolling 8.927 → 8.712; AAPL printed lower highs ($334.99 on 07-17 → $329.00 on 07-22) with a −2.14% reversal on 07-20; and the support cushions are smaller than one risk unit — 10-EMA $322.88 is 0.92% away, VWMA $319.48 is 2.0% away, against an ATR of $8.02 (2.46%) — so ordinary volatility can break both without a thesis change. Layered on are the forward EPS headwinds the panel repeatedly flags: 17.5% tax rate as the new baseline (vs 15.5%), a 25.3% H1 buyback cut with net share count −0.71%, H1 OCF flattered by an $11.3B lower cash-tax payment and a $22.5B working-capital release that likely reverses, inventory +18% into Q3, and a $12.8B intangible build with no discrete acquisition line. After +20.25% YTD and +21.3% in 15 sessions, that March-quarter strength is already paid for, and no valuation multiple exists in the dataset to argue otherwise.

What keeps this Underweight rather than Sell/deeper de-risk is the neutral analyst's correct defense: the primary trend is fully stacked and rising (10-EMA $322.88 > 50-SMA $304.89 > 200-SMA $275.28), MACD is still above signal (8.712 vs 7.113), VWMA has climbed $300.72 → $319.48 in three weeks, price is only −2.35% off its record close, and the pullback is on shrinking volume (63.41M → 38.76M) — distribution of momentum, not of shares. That is why the conservative analyst's "take the whole trim immediately, depend on no bounce" and the aggressive analyst's full re-risk on a single $335 close both overreach. My own record reinforces the moderate path: the 2026-06-30 and 2026-07-01 AAPL Underweights (+8.3%, +7.4% raw) were wrong for trimming into a confirmed uptrend, so the fix is the neutral construction — trim modestly, execute roughly half at market and hold half for strength, complete the trim on a defined no-bounce window or a high-volume break of $322.88, and require confirmation (not price alone) before re-risking.

Data gaps stated plainly: no holdings or cash were provided, so sizing is a fraction of the caller's current AAPL weight, not a dollar amount; there are no AAPL filings past 2026-03-28, no news for July 15–20, and no sentiment or valuation multiple data, so this is a technical-plus-forward-fundamentals call. Upgrades: a controlled hold of $314.86–$317.31 with VWMA still rising, or a decisive close above $333.74–$335 on ≥70M shares with the histogram re-expanding above 2.5 (added in stages, preferably post-Q3). Downgrades: a close below $319.48 opens $310.06 then $304.89 (50-SMA); a decisive breakdown of $304.89 shifts to deeper Underweight/Sell.

**Price Target**: 318.0

**Time Horizon**: 1-3 months tactical (spanning the pending Q3 print)

REFLECTION:
The 5-day +6.2% alpha (raw +3.8%) went against the Underweight call — trimming at $325.89 sold into strength — though five sessions cannot validate or refute a 1–3 month thesis spanning an unresolved Q3 print. What this window undercuts is the "distribution of momentum" read: the MACD histogram decay and lower highs did not translate into the high-volume break of $322.88 the plan required, and the stacked rising MA stack proved the better signal, repeating the 2026-06-30 and 2026-07-01 Underweight error (+8.3%, +7.4%). The lesson: in a fully stacked rising trend, treat momentum decay as a reason to shrink size, not to trim—require an actual close below the 10-EMA/VWMA on expanding volume as the trigger, and let the defined no-bounce window do the work rather than pre-empting it.

# AAPL — Technical Analysis Report (as of close 2026-08-04)

## 1. What the tape just did

AAPL printed a violent two-session air-pocket at the end of July, then stabilized on the session I'm analyzing.

- **Record close:** 340.08 on 2026-07-28 (intraday high 344.57 on 2026-07-29).
- **2026-07-31:** gapped down to a 304.81 open from a 333.43 prior close (−8.6% gap), traded 310.69 high to **300.00 low**, closed 308.91 on **132.49M shares** — roughly 2.4x the ~55M average of the prior 22 sessions (computed from the tool's own rows).
- **2026-08-03:** continued down to a 303.42 close (low 302.56) on 75.05M shares.
- **2026-08-04 (verified snapshot):** open 302.73, low 301.32, high 310.42, **close 309.38**, volume 68.00M. That is a **+1.96%** day that closed in the upper third of its range, above the 300–302 shelf.

Net: **−9.03% from the 340.08 record close in four sessions**, but the last session is a constructive reversal candle, not another capitulation bar. The pullback has retraced price back into the **308.63–312.66** zone that was the launch pad on 2026-07-02/07-06 — i.e., a retest of the breakout area rather than a full trend break.

## 2. Indicator selection (8 core) and why

The market context is *a high-momentum uptrend that has just suffered a high-volume shock* — so I need (a) multi-horizon trend structure, (b) momentum confirmation/divergence, (c) volatility for risk sizing, and (d) volume-weighted price to test whether the selling was distribution.

| Indicator | Value 2026-08-04 | Why it matters here |
|---|---|---|
| close_50_sma | 309.61 | Price is sitting *exactly* on it (309.38). This is the pivotal line of the whole setup. |
| close_200_sma | 278.54 | Strategic trend anchor; defines the bull-market line and the downside magnet. |
| close_10_ema | 320.45 | Captures the short-term break; also the first real resistance overhead. |
| macd | 3.110 | Still positive → the shock is a momentum reset, not yet a zero-line trend flip. |
| macds | 6.631 | Crossed **above** the MACD line on 2026-07-31 → bearish trigger. |
| rsi | 44.68 | Overbought condition (71.65 on 07-17) fully unwound without a price collapse to oversold. |
| atr | 9.775 | Volatility repriced +22% on 07-31 (8.06 → 9.87); essential for stops and sizing. |
| vwma | 323.70 | Volume-weighted cost of the recent advance sits **above** price → recent buyers are underwater (distribution signature). |

*Supplementary cross-check (not counted in the core 8): the Bollinger envelope from the verified snapshot — middle 323.841, upper 345.657, lower 302.025. The 08-04 close sits only ~17% of the way up from the lower band, inside a still-very-wide ~43.6-point envelope (~13.5% of the middle band) that is a direct volatility read on the shock.*

## 3. Trend structure — three timeframes, three different answers

**Long term (bullish, intact).** Close 309.38 is **+11.07% above the 200SMA (278.54)**, and the 50SMA (309.61) is **31.07 points (+11.2%) above** the 200SMA. The golden-cross configuration has been in place all year and the 200SMA is still rising steadily (277.96 on 07-31 → 278.54 on 08-04, ~+0.4/5 sessions). Nothing in the long-term data says this uptrend is over; the 200SMA has not been touched since Q1 (the January–March base lows of 243.42 on 2026-01-20 and 245.51 on 2026-03-30).

**Medium term (deteriorating / at the decision point).** The 50SMA has gone flat: 309.30 (07-30) → 309.50 (07-31) → 309.52 (08-03) → 309.61 (08-04). A flattening 50SMA after a parabolic run is the classic signature of a trend transitioning to neutral. Price closing at 309.38 versus a 309.61 50SMA is a **coin-flip test** — a break of it in either direction is a legitimate signal, but the *slope* of the average has stopped helping the bulls.

**Short term (bearish).** Price is **3.45% below the 10EMA (320.45)**, which itself peaked at 331.31 on 07-30 and has fallen four straight sessions. VWMA (323.70) peaked 329.58 on 07-30 and has also turned down for four sessions, and price is **4.42% below it**. A price below both the fast EMA and the volume-weighted average means the average recent buyer — including everyone who bought the July breakout — is now holding a loss. That is overhead supply, and it is why the 320–324 area is the critical overhead test.

## 4. Momentum — the reset, quantified

- **RSI** fell from 71.65 (2026-07-17) to 40.34 (2026-08-03) — a **31.3-point collapse in 11 sessions** — and has ticked back to **44.68**. Important nuance: RSI never reached 30. It got to 40.3 and bounced, which historically in a strong uptrend (RSI in the 60s–70s for weeks) is the *shallow* version of a reset. But 44.68 is also unambiguously below the 50 midline, so the immediate momentum bias is negative-neutral, not positive.
- **MACD:** the line peaked at 9.609 on 07-29 and is now 3.110 (−6.50), with the signal at 6.631. The bearish crossover occurred **on 2026-07-31** and the histogram has deteriorated monotonically: +0.643 (07-30) → −1.367 (07-31) → −2.978 (08-03) → **−3.521 (08-04)**. Note the histogram's *rate* of deterioration slowed slightly on 08-04 (change of −0.54 vs −1.61 the prior session) — early deceleration, not yet a turn.
- **Key distinction:** the MACD line at +3.110 remains above zero. This is a bearish cross *within* a positive regime. A close of the MACD line below zero would be the second, more serious confirmation, and it would likely coincide with a break of the 300–302 shelf.

## 5. Volatility and risk — the most actionable part

ATR rose from 8.06 (07-30) to **9.775 (08-04)**, a **+21.3%** expansion in three sessions. At 3.16% of the 309.38 close, this repriced daily risk materially.

- **Hard stops based on 1x ATR from the 309.38 close** land near **299.60** — essentially the 300.00 low of 07-31. A 2x ATR stop lands near **289.8**.
- **Practical implication:** position size should be cut roughly 20% versus late July for the same dollar risk. A 1.5x ATR (≈14.7 points) risk unit is a reasonable swing-trade framework.
- The 08-04 session range was 9.10 points (301.32–310.42), very close to 1 ATR — normal for this new regime, not an outlier.
- Bollinger width of ~43.6 points means a "normal" move from the middle band (323.84) to the lower band (302.03) is fully achievable in a few sessions, which is exactly what happened between 07-30 and 08-03. Don't treat lower-band contact as a bounce signal on its own.

## 6. Volume — the tell behind the drop

The 132.49M shares on 07-31 is the second-highest volume in the entire trailing year of this dataset, behind only 261.78M on 2026-06-26. The combination of a −8.6% gap, a close near the low of the range, and 2.4x average volume is textbook **distribution**, and the VWMA turning down for four sessions confirms it: the volume-weighted cost basis (323.70) is now above spot.

There is a mitigating detail: volume *declined* on the two sessions after the shock (132.49M → 75.05M → 68.00M) while price held the 300.00 line. Fading volume on a retest is more consistent with panic exhaustion than with a sustained institutional exit. The prior comparable shock in this dataset — the 2026-06-25 gap down from a 293.08 close to 275.15 (−6.1%) on 107.01M shares, with a 273.75 low — was fully retraced within five sessions (close back to 294.38 by 07-01). That is a *precedent in the data*, not a guarantee, but it argues for treating this as a shakeout until the 300 level actually breaks.

**Immediate support / pivot**
- **309.61** — 50SMA; 309.38 close is *on* it. This is the line in the sand for the neutral thesis.
- **308.63–312.66** — the 07-02 and 07-06 closes, i.e., the breakout shelf price has retraced into.
- **301.32–302.56** — 08-04 low, 08-03 low, and the lower Bollinger band at 302.03. A confluence shelf.
- **300.00** — 07-31 low; the psychological and structural floor of the shock.

**Resistance**
- **320.45** — 10EMA (fast, falling).
- **321.66** — 07-23 close, the last minor swing low before the final leg up.
- **323.70 / 323.84** — VWMA and Bollinger middle band. **A close above this cluster is the single cleanest proof that the shock is fully absorbed.**
- **333.43** — 07-30 close (the pre-gap close); the gap-fill objective.
- **340.08 / 344.57** — record close (07-28) and record intraday high (07-29).

**Downside if the shelf fails**
- **293.08–294.38** — 2026-06-24 close / 07-01 close region, an intermediate pause zone.
- **278.54** — 200SMA, only ~10% below spot and the strategic line.
- **273.75** — 2026-06-25 low, sitting just below the 200SMA. A 274–279 confluence is the "trend repair or trend break" zone.

## 8. Actionable playbook

**Bull / continuation (base case leans slightly this way, but is conditional):** The 08-04 reversal (low 301.32, close 309.38, upper-third of range) plus fading volume plus a still-positive MACD line argues the 300–302 shelf is being defended. Confirmation requires **two consecutive closes back above 320.45 (10EMA)**, then a break of **323.70–323.84 (VWMA / mid-band)**. Above that, the 333.43 gap-fill and a retest of 340.08 become live. Stop for such a setup belongs below **300.00**, sized at ~1x ATR (9.78) or better.

**Bear / failure:** A **daily close below 300.00** invalidates the reversal day and the lower band, and converts the 50SMA cross into a genuine medium-term breakdown. First objective 293–294, then 278.54 (200SMA). A concurrent MACD line push below zero would raise confidence in that path materially.
